paragraphs: Rabbi Avdimi Malcha. He dealt in salt (Jerusalem Talmud, end of chapter Hazahav). Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba ordered him to go sleep in the sukkah, there, chapter Hayashen, halakhah 5.
